corpus.include: institution/**/*.md and docs/**/*.md, plus explicitly listed root files
corpus.exclusionRule: Only Markdown documents under the canonical corpus roots (institution/ for canonical institutional governance assets, docs/ for website-scoped implementation documentation) are governed corpus members, plus explicitly listed root-level operational instruction files. The workbench (workbench/) is structurally outside the corpus: it stages non-admitted working material that carries no institutional status (see workbench/README.md). Application source, configuration, and metadata/validation assets are technical artifacts, not corpus documents. This rescoping was executed by the Repository Foundation migration; the original docs-only rule is preserved in ADR-0001 as decision history.

documents.title: Huerta Group LLC — Documentation Index
documents.summary: Canonical index of governing and launch documentation: defines the document classifications, the five-level hierarchy of authority, canonical-location and no-duplication rules, and conflict escalation.
unresolved: No governing reference states a classification for the documentation index itself.
No governing reference states an authority tier for the documentation index itself.

documents.title: Huerta Group LLC Constitution (canonical record)
documents.statusNote: Records ratified Articles I–III by title only; the verbatim ratified text awaits insertion through the appropriate Company authority. The absence of the full text does not diminish the articles' ratified status.
documents.summary: The single canonical repository record of the Huerta Group LLC Constitution — the highest internal authority — with the rules governing the record itself.

provenance.approvalReference: Formally ratified per the document's own status statement; Articles I–III closed to ordinary revision.

documents.title: Vision Foundation for Development
documents.summary: Approved strategic foundation for all technology and development decisions: Company identity, value-creation model, technology/AI/software philosophy, and strategic guardrails.

provenance.approvalReference: Listed as Approved Strategic Authority by the documentation index (docs/README.md).

documents.title: Development Standards
documents.summary: How Huerta Group LLC systems are designed, implemented, reviewed, documented, and maintained: architecture, code quality, accessibility, security, AI use, content standards, deployment, and change control.

documents.title: Bounded Autonomous Completion and Verification Standard
documents.summary: Default execution method for consequential development tasks: the bounded builder–inspector–repair loop, verification requirements, protected actions, stop conditions, and evidence-based completion.

documents.title: Launch Readiness — Authoritative Record
documents.summary: Authoritative launch-readiness record: verified production state, route inventory, inquiry/notification standby state, environment-variable categories, navigation capacity, verified limitations, and protected owner decisions.

documents.title: Custom-Domain Migration Plan
documents.statusNote: Plan only; the intended domain is not owned, connected, or active. Execution requires owner authorization.
documents.summary: Owner-gated plan for migrating the public website from the active Vercel origin to the official custom domain: decisions, DNS/TLS, canonical cutover, verification, and rollback.

documents.title: Official Launch Checklist
documents.statusNote: Owner-gated items are never marked complete by development.
documents.summary: Phased checklist for the owner-authorized official launch: owner authorizations, pre-launch technical verification, domain migration, inquiry-notification activation, launch verification, and post-launch steps.

documents.title: Rollback Plan
documents.summary: Rollback procedures and responsibility boundaries for the public website: git, deployment-platform, environment, canonical-origin, and DNS rollback, with triggers and post-rollback verification.

documents.title: Internal Software Architecture Foundation
documents.summary: The technical architecture governing future Huerta Group systems: boundaries, data ownership, integration, environment, and identity direction, dependency sequencing, and the capability map. Authorizes no construction; creates no institutional authority.

documents.title: Architecture Decision Record Practice
documents.summary: When an ADR is required, naming and status conventions, required sections, supersession handling, knowledge-manifest integration, ratification rules, and the boundary between technical and institutional decisions.

provenance.approvalReference: Grounded in the Development Standards' written-decisions provision and the ADR-0001 precedent.

documents.title: ADR-0002 — Public Website Boundary
documents.summary: The public website remains a stable, bounded public interface; institutional systems are not built inside it by default; inquiry intake remains colocated with a recorded extraction trigger.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0003 — Application and Repository Boundary Strategy
documents.summary: No global repository topology is mandated; each future capability's application and repository placement is decided by its own ADR against explicit criteria; shared services are extracted only when a second real consumer exists.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0004 — Data Ownership and Supabase Boundary
documents.summary: The current Supabase project owns inquiry records only and is not the universal Company database; one authoritative owner per data category; future data topology remains unresolved with explicit criteria for deciding it later.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0005 — Environment Strategy
documents.summary: Production-first discipline is preserved for the public website; isolated environments, credentials, and migration testing become mandatory the moment any system stores client-confidential, learner, IP, identity, operationally consequential, financial, or regulated data.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0006 — Identity and Access Direction
documents.summary: Authentication arrives only with the first real consumer, then as a shared service; conceptual technical user classes are defined; technical permissions never constitute institutional authority; provider selection remains unresolved.

provenance.approvalReference: Accepted per the document's own status line, under the ADR practice ratification rule.

documents.title: ADR-0001 — Institutional Knowledge Foundation
documents.summary: Architecture decision establishing the machine-readable institutional knowledge layer: metadata schema, corpus manifest, deterministic validation, identifier and relationship conventions, and explicit non-commitment to any future platform.

provenance.approvalReference: Created under the Development Standards provision for decision records (now institution/decisions/).
